The first ready-built version of inkpainter3d, a free, open-source 3D texture painter.
It is early: expect rough edges, and keep backups of your projects.

**What it can do**
- Import FBX, glTF and OBJ; every material becomes a texture set
- Paint with pen pressure, brush presets, stencils, symmetry and polygon fill
- A layer stack with paint and fill layers, folders, blend modes, masks, generators,
  color selection, blur and geometry masks
- Bake mesh maps and use smart materials; CC0 materials from ambientCG and Poly Haven in
  the shelf
- Save projects and export textures for Blender, Unity (Built-in, URP, HDRP), Godot and glTF

**Next:** the projection tool and anchor points.
